topics.title: Iman aur Ibadat
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Suno! Aaj hum 'Iman aur Ibadat' seekhenge — adab aur pyar ke sath.

## SAMJHAO
Grade 3 ke liye asaan baat: Iman aur Ibadat. Yeh Islam ki khoobsurat taleem hai. Key points: Iman, Ibadat, Namaz, Quran.

## MISAAL
Islamabad / ghar / school mein isay amal mein lao — jaise Iman aur Ibadat.

## KARO
Aaj ek kaam: Iman dil mein. Phir family ko batao ke aapne kya seekha.

## SAWAAL
1) Iman aur Ibadat ka matlab kya hai?
2) Aap ghar mein isay kaise amal karoge?
3) Ek misaal do.
